preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines() for x in line.split() if x.isdigit())
preconditions.description: All integers in input are within the bounds 1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5 and 0 ≤ m ≤ min((n(n-1))/(2), 10^5).
The input has exactly m + 1 lines: the first line contains n and m, followed by m lines of edge pairs.
Each of the m edge lines contains exactly two integers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(a) <= n and 1 <= int(b) <= n and int(a) != int(b) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for a, b in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: Each edge pair (a_i, b_i) satisfies 1 ≤ a_i, b_i ≤ n and a_i ≠ b_i.

preconditions.expression: len({(int(a), int(b)) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for a, b in [line.split()]}) == m
preconditions.description: No edge appears twice in the input.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the weight of the minimum spanning tree (MST) of the graph.

The MST weight is (m - (n - 1)) if there are at least (n - 1) edges of weight 1 (since the MST must include exactly (n - 1) edges, and the rest are weight 0). Otherwise, the MST weight is 0 (all edges are weight 0).
